L2_object_move: {obj_move_source}={obj_a} now refers to the actual moved object and may be the support root.
{obj_query}={obj_b} is the obj_query, namely the entity whose final relative position is asked about.
If {obj_query} is supported by another object, {obj_move_source} should be the bottom-most support object.
If {obj_query} is not supported by any object, {obj_move_source} should be {obj_query} itself.
{obj_ref} will not be the same object as {obj_query} or {obj_move_source}.
For object-motion prompts, forward/backward should be expanded to forward (away from the camera) / backward (toward the camera). Camera-motion prompts use camera-specific wording in code.
